quarterly_data.quarter: Modine press release: Modine Completes Spin-off and Combination of its (10-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Modine completed the spin-off of its Performance Technologies business and its combination with Gentherm (Reverse Morris Trust), leaving a portfolio focused on data center cooling, commercial HVAC and refrigeration. President and CEO Neil D. Brinker: completing the transaction 'marks an important milestone in our evolution to a diversified thermal management company serving high-growth markets', and the company can now 'devote our resources and 80/20 discipline to the markets where our thermal management expertise can make the greatest difference for customers'.
